cards.card_text: The news spreads to all Israel: “Saul has attacked an outpost of the Philistines, and now Israel has become a stench to the Philistines!” Jonathan does the attacking and Saul gets the headline, just like the time I stamped a THOUSAND cookies and everybody thanked the OVEN.
cards.verse_text: And all Israel heard the news: “Saul has attacked an outpost of the Philistines, and now Israel has become a stench to the Philistines!” Then the people were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.
